verdict.rationale: The Florida Department of Revenue is a government tax-filing and payment portal, not a platform where users build or host automations, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is outside its product category. The XML schema packages, batch enrollment files, and the emailed reversal of E-Verify certification status are filing mechanisms, not automation lifecycle controls, and do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
